name: vanilla_transfer
description: For transferring characters from a Vanilla (1-60) server to a WotLK server. Caps level at 60 and gold at 100g. Talents excluded - Vanilla trees do not map to Wrath specs. Hearthstone excluded - inn binding IDs differ between expansions. Custom item templates excluded - Vanilla-era custom entries are unlikely to be valid on a WotLK database.
